title: Programmed for Unhappiness
subtitle: Exposing the Untold Truth
author: Rebecca L. Norrington
description: In this international bestseller, Rebecca exposes 55 programmed behaviors — across three levels — that have been proven to subtract from happiness, inner peace, and contentment. Controversial and empowering, this book challenges everything you think you know about why you're unhappy and hands you the tools to change it. A must-read for anyone ready to take radical responsibility for their own joy.
